name: OCR Extraction
description: Extracts exact on-screen text with bounding boxes and temporal tracking using EasyOCR. Wired into the DAG but deselected by default - see library/tools/run_scope.DESELECTED_BY_DEFAULT.

inputs.name: raw_footage_files
inputs.description: Source clips to read text off, from step 1.01.

inputs.name: temporal_index
inputs.description: Per-clip temporal index. Used only to sample at scene boundaries; the step falls back to the layout's own index directory, and to a plain 1fps sample, when it is absent.
